t.zh: 出门之前去商店补货。有的东西只有一件，比如帐篷、相机；有的要多少有多少，比如矿泉水、饼干。物品栏里标着 ×n 的，可以拿很多件。
t.en: Before setting off, you stock up at a shop. Some things come only once, like the tent or the camera; some come in any number, like water or biscuits. Items marked ×n can be taken many times.

t.zh: 本格信息里多了一条「这件能拿多次」。
t.en: The cell facts now include “can take many”.

goal.zh: 每件东西要么最多拿一件，要么可以拿很多件，总重量不能超过容量。算出每个背包最多能装多少价值。
goal.en: Each thing can be taken either at most once or as many times as you like, and the total weight can’t exceed the capacity. Work out the most value each backpack can hold.

how.zh: 物品栏里标 ×n 的可以拿很多件。
how.en: Items marked ×n can be taken many times.

body.zh: 每一行只看这一种东西：最多拿一件，就从上一行腾地方；能拿很多件，就从本行腾地方。
body.en: Each row looks at one kind only: if it can be taken at most once, make room on the row above; if many times, make room on this row.

body.zh: 前面两种背包都是它的特例：全都最多拿一件，就是 0/1 背包；全都能拿很多件，就是完全背包。这块电路板，也能直接解<level-ref to="knapmany"></level-ref>。
body.en: The two earlier backpacks are special cases of it: everything at most once is the 0/1 knapsack, everything many times is the unbounded knapsack. This circuit board solves <level-ref to="knapmany"></level-ref> as it is.

say.zh: 这一关有的东西只能拿一件，有的可以拿很多件。读一读「这件能拿多次」。
say.en: In this level some things can be taken only once and some many times. Read “can take many”.

hints.zh: 两种东西的拿法只差一处：腾地方的那一格，在上一行，还是在本行。
hints.en: The two kinds of thing differ in one place only: whether the cell that makes room is on the row above or on this row.

hints.zh: 让「这件能拿多次」来挑那一格：一个闸门放行本行那格，另一个闸门放行上一行那格。
hints.en: Let “can take many” pick that cell: one gate lets this row’s cell through, another lets the row above’s through.
